sentences.text:
Petitioner
 Versus
 1. The State of Bihar
2. Puja Kumari D/O Radheyshyam Uadhyay, W/O Dhananjay Pandey R/O
Village- Ratanpura Basant, P.S- Avtarnagar, Distt.- Saran At Chhapra.

Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Chandra Mohan Jha, Advocate
 For the O.P. No.2 : Mr. Mithilesh Kumar Arya, Advocate

For the State : Mr. Nagendra Prasad, A.P.P.
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Purnendu Singh
 Oral Order

Heard Mr. Chandra Mohan Jha, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner, Mr.
Mithilesh Kumar Arya, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the O.P. No.2 and Mr. Nagendra Prasad, learned APP for the State.

2. The petitioner seeks pre-arrest bail in connection with Complaint Case No. 3388 of 2021 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 379 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. The present case relates to matrimonial dispute between the parties who are husband and wife.

4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of complainant submitted that O.P. No.2 is ready to live along with Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.52490 of 2023(2) dt.19-08-2023 the petitioner subject to the condition that petitioner fulfills all her physical and financial desire as and when she demands for living a comfortable life and keeps her with fulfill dignity and honour.

5. Mr. Chandra Mohan Jha, learned counsel appearing on behalf of petitioner willingly agreed to Dhananjay Pandey vs The State Of Bihar on 19 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176993099/
1 mediate between the parties.

entities.text: Dhananjay Pandey vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Mr. Mithilesh Kumar Arya, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the O.P. No.2 also agreed that he will cooperate in the mediation taking into consideration that they have two minor children so they strive for amicable settlement of matrimonial dispute between the husband and the wife.
6. Both the parties

are directed to appear before Mr. Chandra Mohan Jha, learned counsel appearing on behalf of petitioner and Mr. Mithilesh Kumar Arya, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the O.P. No.2, who will fix a date within three weeks and will try to strive for amicable settlement of matrimonial dispute between the husband and the wife.

7. Considering the above submission made on behalf of the parties, both the parties are directed to file a joint affidavit before the court below to the effect that the parties have agreed to live together and petitioner must give specific statement in the said joint affidavit that he undertakes to fulfill all physical as Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.52490 of 2023(2) dt.19-08-2023 well as financial requirement of the complainant so that she can lead a dignified life without any interference of any of the family members of the petitioner.

8. If such affidavit is filed within a period of four weeks, petitioner, above named, is directed to be released on pre-arrest bail, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the Court below within a period of four weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned S.D.J.M., Saran in connection with Complaint Case No. 3388 of 2021, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
9.
It is made clear that no coercive step shall be taken against the petitioner for four weeks from the date of passing of this order to enable him to file joint affidavit.

In case, the petitioner is not able to persuade the complainant, in that case, the court below must proceed to mediate between the parties and see that the parties resolve their dispute amicably and lead a happy matrimonial life.

The court below is at liberty to extend the time required for the said purpose taking into consideration that the court should strive for amicable settlement of matrimonial dispute between the husband and the wife till last.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.52490 of 2023(2) dt.19-08-2023 10.
The bail application stands disposed of.

(Purnendu Singh, J)
